props.author: HeartCanHodl
props.text: Ironically, the best place to cover shorts is often where the market feels the worst. When gloom is universal, portfolios have been round-tripped, and frustration has turned into anger, the fuel for further downside is often depleted. Bears should rather thank the market for such clear short-covering zone signs.
Market psychology thesis reinforcing HCH's short-basket conviction (BTC targets 60.8K/59.3K); validates cover-at-capitulation approach.
